title: jacobaea lycopifolia
intro: Jacobaea lycopifolia, commonly known as Riddell's golden ragwort, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) native to North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which provide relief from various health issues. The plant is known to possess health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, inflammation, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Jacobaea lycopifolia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
